text:
sophia_cs: Heads-up — LumenPay hit a SIG/CAIQ deadline and can't produce the requested KMS/HSM attestation + audit log export. They report 401s when trying to pull the keystore export and say the audit log CSV is missing event_type columns. They need an answer by EOD Fri (3 days). Copying their snippet below.

LumenPay (customer): Can you produce a signed HSM attestation and the audit log export for the last 36 months? We keep getting 401 on `/admin/keystore/export` and the CSV from `Audit -> Exports` has blank event_type values for most rows. This is blocking our SIG submission.

caroline_cs: Noted. They also asked about retention windows — they need 36 months. Our standard is 90d. I told them I'd escalate.

ryan_se: @sophia_cs can you confirm which API client they used (API key vs service account)? 401s usually mean auth token or scope mismatch.

sophia_cs: They tried their org API key via curl. Here is their command they pasted:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/admin/keystore/export -o keystore.json
```

They get `401 Unauthorized` immediately. No body sometimes, just status.

priya_eng: Quick checklist: 1) confirm the key is for org admin role, 2) check if the key is scoped to hosted-only, 3) check OIDC token expiry if using SA tokens.

sophia_cs: I confirmed with the customer: the key is org-level but was generated by a user who left last month. They rotated it today and still hit 401s.

ryan_se: Ok please capture the request/response headers and the exact time. Also ask them to try a service-account JWT flow to rule out key scoping. Example curl for SA token exchange: `curl -X POST https://auth.redwood-inference.com/token -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=...&client_secret=..."` then use returned `access_token`.

priya_eng: I'm going to triage the CSV issue in parallel. Event types blank -> likely a pipeline bug during the export job where enums map to empty string if lookup fails. I need an export job id. sophia, can you ask for the export_id (visible in UI under Audit > Exports) or the timestamp range they used?

sophia_cs: Asking now. They gave export modal screenshot but not the id. Also asked them to attempt the SA flow and to paste raw headers.

caroline_cs: Customer is pushing—they want a fallback plan if we can't provide 36mo retention. Mentioned legal requires it for SIG.

oliver_pm: Flagging potential product change: enterprise retention extension + export-backfill for compliance. Priya, what's effort to backfill >90d?

priya_eng: Backfill depends on cold archives. We stream audit events to object storage for 12 months by default, but older than 12m may have been pruned unless account opted into long-retention. For 36m backfill we may need to rehydrate from cold storage and validate integrity — estimate 3-5 days work + ops window. Need security sign-off.

secops_bot: @security-team FYI — potential attestation/HSM request from LumenPay. Ticket created: SEC-8421. Please advise on legal wording for attestation exports and whether we can generate a signed HSM attestation for hosted customers.

priya_eng: For the CSV bug, here's a quick repro we ran on staging:

```
# create synthetic audit event with event_type indexing
POST /v1/admin/audit-events
{ "user": "test", "event_type": "key.export", "meta": {} }
# run export job
POST /v1/admin/audit-exports {"from":"2023-01-01","to":"2023-12-31"}
# fetch job results -> CSV shows empty event_type when lookup table returns null
```

Root cause: a cache expiry race where schema migration created a new enum mapping and old export workers didn't pick it up. Patch ready (worker restart + fallback mapping). Will push a hotfix to staging now.

ryan_se: For the 401: we checked logs for their org id at 2026-03-10T14:32:10Z and saw `auth: missing_scope` on the gateway with key id `sk_live_abc123`. This indicates the key lacked `admin:export` scope. If they rotated the key, ensure new key has the right role. I DM'd them example perms.

sophia_cs: Customer says new key shows `role: org_admin`. They also ran `service_account` path and still saw 401. They pasted the raw response header: `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="api", error="insufficient_scope", scope="admin:read"`.

priya_eng: That header is telling: the token's scope is `admin:read` not `admin:export`. Could be our UI role/permission mapping bug when keys are rotated via API vs console. I'll trace rotation endpoint.

caroline_cs: Customer asked if we can do a one-off export ourselves to unblock the SIG. Can we provide an HSM-signed export (PDF + attestation) as an exception?

priya_eng: We can produce an export manually if security approves. Two things required: 1) confirmation of PII handling & redaction policy, 2) signed attestation from HSM vendor or our KMS provider. secops_bot, can you advise timeline to produce signed attestation?

secops_bot: Security: we can produce a tenant-level attestation signed with our HSM key in ~4 business days after vetting scope. If customer needs vendor-signed HSM attestation, that may need vendor coordination (1-2 weeks). Also need customer NDA addendum for long-retention.

oliver_pm: We need to communicate realistic timelines to the customer: CSV fix hotfix ETA 2h for event_type blank patch (we'll restart workers), auth issue likely user-key-scope mismatch (we can confirm). For 36mo retention/backfill + signed attestation -> 5-12 business days depending on vendor.

sophia_cs: I told the customer: 1) try regenerated org-admin key (confirm `admin:export` scope) + SA flow — Ryan provided exact curl. 2) We're applying a hotfix for CSV event_type now. 3) Security will scope attestation process and timelines. 4) If needed we can do a one-off manual export post-security sign-off. They accepted tentative plan and asked for a written timeline.

priya_eng: Hotfix pushed to staging, rolling to prod in 20m. We'll restart export workers, monitor a sample export. If that fixes event_type blanks, we can backfill any missed exports created in the last 48h.

ryan_se: For customer troubleshooting: please ask them to run this exact curl and paste response headers (sanitise tokens):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/admin/keystore/export"
```
Look for `WWW-Authenticate` header. If it shows `insufficient_scope` we can close on permissions.

caroline_cs: Customer will run tests now and send headers. They've requested written confirmation that we can produce a signed HSM attestation if necessary. I offered to add that to the timeline with Security's wording.

secops_bot: I'll prepare a standard attestation template and timeline blurb and attach to SEC-8421. Expect draft in ~24 hours.

sophia_cs: Updated customer — they ran the curl after rotation and SA flow. Result: SA flow works (200) but API key still 401. They will use SA for the export for now. They confirmed one export job succeeded and attached CSV — event_type still blank for older rows.

priya_eng: Since SA flow works, auth problem is confirmed to be api-key-scoping/regeneration path. We'll file a bug to prevent future key-scope drift. For CSV blank rows we will re-run export job for their range after worker restart and reprocess rows from object storage. Asking infra to prioritize rehydrate for that account.

caroline_cs: Customer requested an official extension on SIG due date by 7 days while we backfill + provide attestation. Legal okayed a 7-day extension if we commit to delivery dates.

oliver_pm: Approve 7-day extension. Priya/Ryan/SecOps — commit to: hotfix + reprocess exports in 48h, SA export workaround immediate, signed attestation draft in 4 business days.

priya_eng: Confirming commit. Will update ticket with runbook and ops steps.

sophia_cs: I sent the timeline to LumenPay and attached the SA export (temporary). They're relieved. I'll keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:
